items.subject: Urgent: Temperature Alarm Cold Storage VZ Duisburg
items.body: Temperature alarm last night at VZ Duisburg cold storage – rose to -14°C (target: -18°C). ~200 pallets of frozen goods affected. "Please check whether the goods can still be used or if we need to request replacement deliveries."

items.subject: Coverage Days Warning: 4 SKUs Below Threshold
items.body: WMS reports 4 SKUs with coverage below 3 days: Bio-Haferflocken (1.8d), Vollmilch 3.5% (2.1d), Espresso Crema (1.5d), Butter (2.4d). "Please prioritize replenishment orders."
Bauckhof substitution for oat flakes is now live. Quality and price confirmed. "No action needed on your end."
Store replenishment for South region completed. 12 stores flagged increased dairy demand due to next week's promotion. "Quantities already forwarded to the distribution center."

items.subject: Delivery Delay Espresso Crema – Expected 3 Days
items.body: Port delays in Hamburg affecting order NC-2024-0847 (Espresso Crema). "New estimated delivery date is end of this week." Consider checking alternative sourcing options.
Dual-sourcing coffee project: test delivery from second supplier arrived. "Initial quality results look good." Sandra wants to discuss tomorrow.

items.subject: Quality Report Vollmilch 3.5% – Current Batch
items.body: Quality report for current Vollmilch 3.5% batch: all parameters within spec, microbiology clear. "Batch is cleared for shipment."
VZ Duisburg at 87% warehouse utilization. "If all replenishment orders for next week come in, it'll be tight." Suggests rerouting some goods to VZ Mülheim.

items.subject: Packaging Transition 2025 – Timeline and Next Steps
items.body: Packaging transition update: Phase 1 (dairy) completed successfully, Phase 2 (dry goods) starts in 2 weeks. "Please check if there are any open items from the procurement side."
Banana delivery arriving tomorrow morning (one day earlier than planned). "DC informed, unloading slot reserved." No action required.
